shortBio.en: Queen’s lead vocalist and pianist; multi-register writing from glam hard rock to disco-tinged pop.
shortBio.zh: Queen 主唱与钢琴手；从 glam hard rock 到带 disco 色彩的流行，跨音域写作。

body.en:
Born Farrokh Bulsara, 1946. With Queen from 1970 until his death in 1991. Piano-led songs and stacked vocal arrangements are his studio signature; live work centers on range and call-and-response with arenas.

Person page exists so Mercury-era Queen stays distinct from later guest-vocal tours.
body.zh:
本名 Farrokh Bulsara，1946 年生。1970 年起在 Queen 直至 1991 年去世。钢琴主导歌曲与堆叠人声编曲是录音室签名；现场工作围绕音域与体育馆呼应。

人物页用来把 Mercury 时期 Queen 与后来的客座主唱巡演分开。

note.zh: 至 Innuendo 的经典四人巅峰。
